Building modern software platforms often feels like riding an endless pendulum. Every decade, the tech industry promises a revolutionary paradigm shift that will solve all our development bottlenecks. Yet engineering budgets keep ballooning, time to market keeps stretching, and decision makers are left asking the exact same question: Why are we burning so much capital just to keep the lights on and ship basic features?

item.title: Kubernetes Bottleneck is Broken, Development Taxes Are Repealed: Announcing HariKube 1.0
item.description:
Table of Contents

  • 🏋️ The End of the Etcd Bottleneck
  • 🏗️ Repealing the “Development Tax”
  • 🎯 Who is HariKube For?
  • 🚀 The Road to 1.0 and Beyond

For too long, the “Kubernetes Tax” has been a mandatory payment for every engineering team. You pay it in time spent configuring YAML, you pay it in cognitive load trying to understand networking, and you pay it in performance when etcd hits its scaling limit.
